CVE-2026-6653.assessment: Installed libxml2 marked vulnerable. Tests supply only trusted fixed SQL and no XML; database has no network or host input mounts. No patch or deployed reachability waiver claimed.

CVE-2025-68121.assessment: Go crypto/tls certificate resumption issue reported for gosu stdlib metadata. Test topology has no network/TLS calls. Binary reachability not independently established; retain finding before deployment.

transaction_settings.assessment: Require READ COMMITTED for fresh post-lock sums and synchronous_commit=on. Actual database rejected alternate isolation settings and nondurable commits. Trusted caller must retain durability settings through commit before external I/O; no provider integration yet.
